### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **320** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/query.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**131** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f`.

⛔ **18** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/query.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `packageId (4 routes)`
- **5** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_FAILED (literal, 39 pages)`, `created_at (literal, 43 pages)`, `/api/v1/data (route, 48 pages)`, `/data/:object (route, 75 pages)`, `/meta/:type/:name (route, 40 pages)`
- **52** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **169** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `dcedc0cf044881cecbe99c515dbe06699775ceec` — the merge of head `fb09f70ad757bee2e4137df6c3029d242832ca26` into base `a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin dcedc0cf044881cecbe99c515dbe06699775ceec && git checkout dcedc0cf044881cecbe99c515dbe06699775ceec
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f fb09f70ad757bee2e4137df6c3029d242832ca26 && git checkout -B drift-repro a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f && git merge --no-ff fb09f70ad757bee2e4137df6c3029d242832ca26

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a2fcede85c09dd54093f03cecc312d0dc861734f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 `protocol.ts` 类定义之上的整段前言(183 条顶层声明，约 6,300 行)原样搬进 22 个按主题命名的 `protocol-*.ts` 模块。`protocol.ts` 照旧导出原来的每个名字，没有逻辑改动。
- 为什么改:`protocol.ts` 是 server 车道的热文件，改它的 PR 都要排队。这是 #25467 裁决 E 的第一步 E0(E1、E2 之后另派),按字母 A 的 `.d.ts` 新判据(归一器 2)落地。
- 风险与回滚：低。工具证明 190/190 条语句逐字搬移，无改动、无多余。对外 `index.d.ts` 归一后哈希与 base 相同，原始差异只有空行、一条 import 内的名字顺序、一个字面量联合的成员顺序三类。回滚即整体 revert。
- 先看:`protocol.ts` 文件头的 import/export 名单，以及两个迁移后的按路径 pin(`protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`、`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`,两个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：改动约 13,200 行，超过 3,000 行人工合并线，请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 在 GitHub 上批准(Approve)。批准后由本席经队列落地，维护者直接合并也可以。`packages/spec/liveness/query.json` 两处引用改指新模块，本席已同意留在本 PR。

席位意见：与 diff 相符。本席自己做了一遍逐行比对(base 删除行对 head 新增行),第一版丢了三段 import 注释和七个只被 `{@link}` 用到的 import 名，已在 `fb09f70ad7` 补回。现在缺的只剩重排过的 import 名单行。

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · `domain:server` seat 5 · `os-steve` · `session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1` · 2026-11-02T12:38Z · head `fb09f70ad7` · #25467 step E0

1. **Shape:** draft against `main`, `Part of #25467` (the series continues with E1/E2), and no closing keyword. **patch** changeset for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec` (the shipped `liveness/` ledger). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Not path-governed; +6,9xx / -6,3xx, 28 files.
2. **Against the order:** ruling E (6537939895) E0 only, under letter A (6545252863). The move was redone by tool on fresh `main`, with the predecessor branch as reference only. The move-only verifier reads 190/190 verbatim, 0 changed, 0 surplus, and a negative control goes red. Normaliser 2 hashes of the published `index.d.ts` are equal base vs head (`7dea44d6…`), with 6 positive and 3 negative controls passing, and no fourth kind of raw difference. On `fb09f70ad7` the raw `.d.ts` is byte-identical to the previous head, so there is no comment leak. The seat's own line-multiset check of base deletions against head additions leaves only re-flowed import-name lines; the patch round restored three import-attached comment blocks (#19295, #21207, #5488) and seven doc-link-only import names. No class-body member is touched.
3. **Accepted deviations:** `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` re-points two evidence citations to the module the symbols moved to (option A of the dev's question). It is a by-path citation with no schema change, and `check:liveness` is red without it. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` re-points three citations. The `protocol.ts` E0 header note is 5 lines; its length was chosen to clear the `.d.ts` comment leak. The dependents typecheck (72/72) was read on `6b1dd49e2b`, and the commits since then are comments, changeset text and imports, with normaliser 2 unchanged.
4. **Gates:** the dev reports 71/71 derived gates exit 0 on `20d8c2c813` (0 NOT-MEASURED). The package suite on that head read 301 files / 22127 tests. On `fb09f70ad7`: tsc and the two by-path pins pass, 11 by-path gates exit 0, and package `eslint` exits 0. The three ablations of the migrated pins each went red and were restored. Check-runs on this head were still running at this record; the seat lands it only after they are green.
5. **Out of scope:** the TS declaration emitter can print a class JSDoc inside `getMetaTypes()`'s inferred return type at some byte layouts of `protocol.ts`. This goes to **E1** as an item: give `getMetaTypes()` an explicit return type. Not filed separately. Hot file: #28731 conflicts on `ConcurrentUpdateError`'s doc comment (now in `protocol-version-tokens.ts`), and whichever lands second carries it. #29270 / #29307 / #29290 / #29295 / #29317 merge clean.
6. **Landing: HUMAN MERGE OR AUTHORIZED APPROVAL.** At 13k+ changed lines, over 3,000, this is Tier H by size. The seat does not flip it ready, enqueue it, or arm auto-merge. The PR carries `needs-user-decision` and waits for an APPROVED review from a GOVERNED_APPROVERS account (os-zhuang, hotlong). After that, this seat lands it through the queue on a green head; the maintainer's own merge is the other landing. A head change after approval needs a re-ACCEPT.
